sample_type.evidence_source: Just above one third of the adolescents (38.2%) were motivated to leave home, while almost the same percentage of adolescents were not (37.6%), and the rest (23.8%) were undecided (see Table 1). Boys, adolescents from high SES and non-intact families, and only child adolescents were more likely to be motivated to leave home compared to girls, adolescents from low-mid SES, intact families and with siblings.
